title: apium wolffianum
intro: Apium wolffianum, commonly known as Wolff's celery, is a type of plant that belongs to the carrot family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Apium wolffianum include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to remove excess fluids from the body, and its potential in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Apium wolffianum include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
